description: This file defines helper classes and base classes for formatters in the behave testing framework, including StreamOpener and Formatter classes.

classes.name: StreamOpener
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to open, manage, and close output streams for formatters.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: Base class for formatters implementing the IFormatter interface, managing output streams and configuration.

methods.name: ensure_dir_exists
methods.description: Creates the directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: ensure_stream_with_encoder
methods.description: Ensures the stream has the correct encoding.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the output stream if it is not already open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the output stream if it was opened by this class.

methods.name: close_stream
methods.description: Closes the stream, delegating to stream_opener.
